title: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.05738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research

translated_title: OdorSpaces：三维环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
translated_abstract: 嗅觉能够提供关于空气传播化学线索的关键信息，但它在具身智能领域仍未得到充分探索，先前的机器嗅觉研究较为有限，且主要聚焦于语义气味感知。我们提出了OdorSpaces，一个基于物理的视觉-嗅觉具身导航仿真平台与基准。OdorSpaces通过火灾动力学模拟器（FDS）模拟的三维气味传输与扩散来增强Habitat-Sim，使智能体能够结合视觉与嗅觉观测在照片级逼真的室内环境中进行导航。该基准包含两个代表性的源头搜索场景：不可见气体泄漏定位与早期火灾定位。我们开发了一个初始的多模态强化学习策略，能够随时间整合视觉观测与嗅觉测量。实验表明，该策略优于多种基线方法，为未来研究建立了强有力的参考。
tldr: 提出OdorSpaces——一个通过FDS模拟三维气味扩散来增强Habitat-Sim的物理仿真平台与基准，支持气体泄漏定位和早期火灾定位等视觉-嗅觉具身导航任务，其多模态强化学习策略优于多种基线方法。
en_tdlr: OdorSpaces is a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark that augments Habitat-Sim with FDS-simulated 3D odor transport, enabling visual-olfactory embodied navigation for source-seeking tasks like invisible gas-leak and early-stage fire localization, with a multimodal reinforcement learning policy that outperforms diverse baselines.
